title: 义务教育教科书·英语（清华）五年级上册

sentences.cn: 这个地方真热闹！
sentences.en: What a busy place this is!

sentences.cn: 山上有一座大城堡。
sentences.en: There is a big castle on the hill.

sentences.cn: 那家饭馆在那栋高楼里。
sentences.en: The restaurant is in that tall building.

sentences.cn: 我胳膊疼，还牙疼。
sentences.en: My arm hurts and I have a toothache.

sentences.cn: 我喉咙疼，说不出话。
sentences.en: I have a sore throat and I cannot speak.

sentences.cn: 公鸡一叫，太阳就从东边升起来。
sentences.en: The rooster crows and the sun rises in the east.

sentences.cn: 太阳很快就要升起来了。
sentences.en: The sun will rise soon.

sentences.cn: 晚上我一页接一页地读。
sentences.en: In the evening I read page after page.

sentences.cn: 她会把贝壳留在家里。
sentences.en: She will leave her shell at home.

sentences.cn: 猫动了动它的尾巴。
sentences.en: The cat moves its tail.

sentences.cn: 我想买这个猴子手偶。
sentences.en: I want to buy this monkey puppet.

sentences.cn: 明天的一切都准备好了。
sentences.en: Everything is ready for tomorrow.

sentences.cn: 打扰一下，请问旅馆在哪儿？
sentences.en: Excuse me, where is the hotel?

sentences.cn: 售货员给我看了一件大夹克。
sentences.en: The salesperson shows me a large jacket.

sentences.cn: 这件夹克是什么尺码？
sentences.en: What size is this jacket?

sentences.cn: 百货商店在车站前面。
sentences.en: The department store is in front of the station.

sentences.cn: 服装部在二楼。
sentences.en: The clothing department is on the second floor.

sentences.cn: 我的房间是几号？
sentences.en: Which number is my room?

sentences.cn: 我迷路了，也找不到我的信箱。
sentences.en: I am lost, and I cannot find my mailbox.

sentences.cn: 总共五十元。
sentences.en: The total is fifty yuan.

sentences.cn: 今天是我们的最后一天，所以我们买了一份沙拉。
sentences.en: This is our last day, so we buy a salad.

sentences.cn: 星期一、星期二和星期三我去上学。
sentences.en: On Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday I go to school.

sentences.cn: 星期四和星期五我们在操场上玩。
sentences.en: On Thursday and Friday we play in the playground.

sentences.cn: 星期六下午我表姐来我家。
sentences.en: On Saturday afternoon my cousin comes to my home.

sentences.cn: 河马很危险，别靠近它。
sentences.en: The hippo is dangerous, so do not go near it.

sentences.cn: 别推，不然你会撞到石头上。
sentences.en: Do not push, or you will hit the rock.

sentences.cn: 我在水坑里伤了腿，大声呼救。
sentences.en: I hurt my leg in the puddle and I shout for help.

sentences.cn: 我们在操场上挖了一个洞。
sentences.en: We dig a hole in the playground.

sentences.cn: 孔雀的尾巴五颜六色。
sentences.en: The peacock has a colorful tail.

sentences.cn: 水坑旁边有一堆石头。
sentences.en: A pile of rocks is next to the puddle.

sentences.cn: 我们突然对着河马笑起来。
sentences.en: Suddenly we laugh at the hippo.

sentences.cn: 请给我一张纸。
sentences.en: Give me a piece of paper, please.

sentences.cn: 你还有纸吗？
sentences.en: Do you have any more paper?

sentences.cn: 然后我们就回家了。
sentences.en: Next, we go home.

sentences.cn: 风刮起来，浪很大。
sentences.en: The wind blows and the waves are big.

sentences.cn: 暴风雨要来了，我们能看见闪电。
sentences.en: A storm is coming, and we can see lightning.

sentences.cn: 暴风雨期间，我们待在洞里。
sentences.en: During the storm, we stay in a cave.

sentences.cn: 一架直升机飞过陆地。
sentences.en: A helicopter flies over the land.

sentences.cn: 地球的轴绕着太阳转。
sentences.en: The axis of the Earth goes around the sun.

sentences.cn: 我们沿着河走，面朝大海。
sentences.en: We walk along the river and face the sea.

sentences.cn: 将来某一天，我想坐一次直升机。
sentences.en: Someday I want to fly in a helicopter.

sentences.cn: 许多成年人中午都没时间小睡一会儿。
sentences.en: Many adults have no time for a nap at noon.

sentences.cn: 大多数鸟都会飞，比如燕子。
sentences.en: Most birds can fly, for example the swallow.

sentences.cn: 老狗慢慢走着，守着自己的骨头。
sentences.en: The old dog walks slowly and keeps its own bone.

sentences.cn: 我没东西可写，只有一个词。
sentences.en: I have nothing to write, only one word.

sentences.cn: 这是书里最重要的一部分。
sentences.en: This is the most important part of the book.

sentences.cn: 我可以问你几个问题吗？
sentences.en: Can I ask you some questions?

sentences.cn: 生命是美好的事物。
sentences.en: Life is a wonderful thing.

sentences.cn: 他在暴风雨中发出了求救信号。
sentences.en: He sends an SOS during the storm.

sentences.cn: 树林中间有一间小房子。
sentences.en: There is a small house among the trees.

sentences.cn: 暴风雨天待在家里是安全的。
sentences.en: It is safe to stay at home in a storm.
